citations.title: Ron Vachris: From Forklift Driver to CEO at Costco

sentences.quote: In October 2023, it was announced that Ron Vachris would succeed CEO Craig Jelinek at the start of 2024, as part of what was described as a "long-standing succession plan."
sentences.text: Vachris, CEO since January 2024, is only the third person to lead Costco since its founding, after James Sinegal and Craig Jelinek; he is a four-decade insider who started as a forklift driver and served in every major role across operations and merchandising, and his elevation completed a long-standing board succession plan.
Execution has followed the established playbook of steady unit growth: 914 warehouses at the end of fiscal 2025 and 939 at the end of fiscal 2026, with 967 planned for fiscal 2027.

Capital returns stay conservative, with fiscal 2025 buybacks of about $903 million, a quarterly dividend rate of $1.30 per share and a $15 per share special dividend, roughly $6.7 billion, paid in fiscal 2024.
